description: Read and write Airtable bases, tables, records, cells and comments (workspaces, schema, records, activity, select choices) through your own logged-in airtable.com web session. Uses the web client's internal /v0.3 API in the current tab.

tools.name: list_workspaces
tools.description: List all workspaces and bases the current user has access to. Returns workspace metadata with nested base (application) information.

tools.name: get_base_schema
tools.description: Get the full schema of an Airtable base including all tables, fields (columns), and views. Use this to understand the structure before reading or writing records.

tools.name: list_records
tools.description: List all records (rows) in a table. Returns record IDs, creation times, and cell values keyed by field ID. Use get_base_schema first to learn the field IDs and their types.

tools.name: get_record
tools.description: Get a single record (row) by its ID. Returns all cell values for the record.

tools.name: update_cell
tools.description: Update a single cell value in a record. The value format depends on the field type: text fields accept strings, number fields accept numbers, select fields accept an object like {"id": "selXxx"}, and so on. Use get_base_schema to discover field IDs and types.

tools.name: get_record_activity
tools.description: Get the activity history and comments for a record. Returns a chronological list of changes (cell updates, record creation, comments, etc.) with user attribution.

tools.name: create_comment
tools.description: Add a comment to a record. Comments are visible to all collaborators on the base.

tools.name: get_field_choices
tools.description: Get the available choices for a single-select or multi-select field. Returns choice IDs, names, and colors. Use the choice ID (sel prefix) when setting cell values for select fields.
